changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Permit a review to stop because the sources of its practices moved with no newer review (SOURCES_MOVED), and keep NOT_RUN, the reason of a practice that was never measured, a known value.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE review DROP CONSTRAINT ck_review_stop_reason;

ALTER TABLE review ADD CONSTRAINT ck_review_stop_reason CHECK(stop_reason IS NULL OR stop_reason IN ('TIMED_OUT','EXECUTION_FAILED','PREPARATION_FAILED','PROCESSING_FAILED','PERSON_DATA_ERASED','STALE_ROLLOUT_REVISION','CANCELLED_BY_ADMIN','REPLACED','LEGACY_FAILURE','EXECUTION_INCOMPLETE','RESULT_WITHHELD','READINESS_REFUSED','SUSPECT_LISTING','BUDGET','USAGE_UNVERIFIABLE','DEADLINE','CANCELLED','ENUMERATION_FAILED','ENUMERATION_LIMIT','NO_SCAN_PRACTICES','MODEL_CHANGED','MODEL_UNAVAILABLE','ERROR','LEGACY_SCOPE_UNKNOWN','CONTRACT_CHANGED','NO_SANDBOX_ROOM','COMPOSITION_UNCONFIRMED','PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE','SOURCES_MOVED','NOT_RUN'));
